brief: An elongated raised stone planting trough with a handful of curved grouped reeds leaning to the right. A tall answering leaf left, dark open notch between leaf masses, visible waterline below; no repetitive grass spikes.
A low broken stone doorway with one living root curving up its left jamb and across the crown; right jamb remains exposed. Root grips stone at both ends; a single clean dark opening.

A short broken ceramic channel supported by masonry, pouring one continuous curved ribbon into a shallow basin. Distinguish thin translucent blue-green water from warm stone, readable as one attached prop.
A low offset stone bench with thick curved seat, two weight-bearing legs and a quiet cushion of moss draped over the left edge. Asymmetrical broad silhouette with negative space under the seat.
A round shallow cistern cut away in three-quarter perspective, broad water plane and two overlapping lily pads at unequal heights. Pale stone rim has one broken section; no floating jewelry.
An angled freestanding stone trellis with two wide open diamonds and a single tapered vine climbing diagonally; three broad leaf clusters, restrained moss, fitted stable foot.
A squat weathered stone seed cabinet with three unequal open pigeonholes and two shallow ceramic seed trays. One broad climbing leaf hugs its right side. Paper and ceramic remain visually distinct.
Two broad stepping stones spanning a narrow U-shaped stone culvert. Dark channel below, one visible blue-green water surface, one mossy bank. The two slabs connect the banks; no impossible support.
